name: Kimi K3 MLX
tagline: Kimi-K3 MoE port for Apple Silicon MLX
description: kimi-k3-mlx is an MLX port of Moonshot's Kimi-K3, a 2.78T-total / 104B-active native-multimodal MoE with a 1M-token context. The repo ships a stock mlx-lm-compatible model definition for the text tower, a vision tower with projector, and an mlx-vlm wrapper, plus a streaming converter that handles the 5.6 TB bf16 source one layer at a time. The mxfp4 tier is a bit-exact passthrough of Moonshot's MXFP4 expert weights, and REAP expert pruning with streaming calibration produces domain-targeted builds that run at interactive speeds on 512 GB Apple Silicon machines.
highlights: Bit-exact MXFP4 passthrough tier at 1.56 TB, verified to zero error end to end
Streaming converter for the 5.6 TB bf16 source, walking one layer at a time
REAP expert pruning with streaming calibration and per-language expert-overlap analysis
Vision tower verified against Moonshot's torch reference at full K3 dimensions (1.5e-6 relative error)
Published pruned builds decode at ~5.5 tok/s on a 512 GB M3 Ultra
curatorNote: A serious engineering effort to make Moonshot's 2.78T-parameter Kimi-K3 run on Apple Silicon. The bit-exact MXFP4 passthrough, streaming converter, and measured REAP pruning analysis set the template for porting frontier-scale MoEs to consumer hardware.
